prose: The Information reports on how Nvidia uses soft power to influence customers and shape US chip policy, with sources saying OpenAI took no public stance on China chip exports to avoid angering Nvidia. It opens with OpenAI researcher Noam Brown posting a news story in a company Slack channel last month.
highlights: Nvidia's soft power over customers and chip policy, per The Information
Sources: OpenAI avoided a public stance on China chip exports to avoid angering Nvidia
basis: Error cache: The Information paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede; claim is attributed to unnamed sources.
